To be clear I can't recommend this instrument to anyone

Try and pick your spots on individual semis but don't overindex to them imo, the market can look past them

Technical context: SOXX (semiconductor ETF) consolidation at lower support levels after recent weakness. Reinforces multi-trader semis convergence thesis (Jul 28-29) with caution on broad sector concentration despite recovery opportunity.
